Negative_Script: If this prototype isn't perfect, I've failed.
Hint_for_Reframe: Is there a middle ground between perfect and failed?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: A rough prototype that teaches me something is more valuable than a perfect one I never ship.

Negative_Script: Everyone else knows more about AI than I do.
Hint_for_Reframe: Are you comparing your beginning to someone else's middle?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I'm earlier in my learning journey, and that's exactly where I'm supposed to be right now.

Negative_Script: I always mess up presentations.
Hint_for_Reframe: Has there ever been ONE time it went okay?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I've struggled with some presentations, but each one teaches me what to improve next time.

Negative_Script: My professor didn't smile during my pitch — they must hate my idea.
Hint_for_Reframe: Can you really know what someone is thinking from one facial expression?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I can't read minds. I'll ask for specific feedback instead of assuming the worst.

Negative_Script: That failed quiz proves I'm not college material.
Hint_for_Reframe: Is one quiz the same as your entire identity?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: One quiz doesn't define my ability — it shows me where to focus my study time.

Negative_Script: My first idea failed, so I'm not a good entrepreneur.
Hint_for_Reframe: Do most successful founders get it right on attempt #1?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: My first idea didn't work YET — but I learned what my customer actually needs.

Negative_Script: The professor didn't like my pitch — I should quit.
Hint_for_Reframe: Did they actually say they didn't like it, or are you interpreting?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I received critical feedback, which means my professor thinks I'm worth investing time in.

Negative_Script: I'm too young to be taken seriously as a founder.
Hint_for_Reframe: What advantages does your age actually give you?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: My age gives me energy, digital fluency, and less to lose — that's a competitive edge.

Negative_Script: If I ask for help, people will think I'm incompetent.
Hint_for_Reframe: What do YOU think when someone asks you for help?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: Asking for help shows self-awareness and resourcefulness — two traits investors look for.

Negative_Script: I got lucky on that last project — next time I'll be exposed.
Hint_for_Reframe: What specific actions did YOU take that led to that success?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I prepared thoroughly, iterated on feedback, and executed — that's skill, not luck.

Negative_Script: I only got into this program because of luck.
Hint_for_Reframe: What did your application actually include?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I earned my spot through my application, my ideas, and my effort — luck didn't write my essays.

Negative_Script: Everyone in this cohort is smarter than me.
Hint_for_Reframe: Are you comparing your insides to their outsides?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I bring a unique perspective that no one else in this room has — that's my value.

Negative_Script: I don't belong in this entrepreneurship class — I'm not a 'business person.'
Hint_for_Reframe: Who decides what a 'business person' looks like?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: Entrepreneurship is about solving problems creatively — and I do that in my own way every day.

Negative_Script: If people knew how confused I actually am, they'd lose respect for me.
Hint_for_Reframe: Is confusion the same as incompetence?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: Confusion means I'm at the edge of my knowledge — that's exactly where growth happens.

Negative_Script: My teammate's MVP looks way more polished — mine is embarrassing.
Hint_for_Reframe: Are you at the same stage of development?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: My MVP is built to learn, not to impress. Function over polish at this stage.

Negative_Script: I bombed my pitch in front of the whole class. I'm not cut out for this.
Hint_for_Reframe: Has any successful founder never bombed a pitch?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: Every great pitcher has a 'worst pitch' story. Today was mine — and now I know exactly what to fix.

Negative_Script: A classmate's startup got featured in the school paper. Mine didn't.
Hint_for_Reframe: Does their visibility diminish your progress?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: Their success doesn't subtract from mine. I'll use this as motivation to tell my story better.

Negative_Script: My prototype broke during the demo. Everyone saw.
Hint_for_Reframe: What did the audience actually learn from that moment?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: A broken demo shows I'm building real things. I'll fix it and the recovery story becomes part of my brand.

Negative_Script: The investor said 'not right now' — that means never.
Hint_for_Reframe: What did they actually say vs. what you're adding?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: 'Not right now' means I need to grow more — and now I know what they're looking for when I come back.

Negative_Script: My team is frustrated with me. I'm a bad leader.
Hint_for_Reframe: Is frustration the same as failure?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: Friction in a team means we care. I'll ask what they need from me and adjust my approach.

Negative_Script: I've come this far but I still don't feel like a 'real' entrepreneur.
Hint_for_Reframe: What would a 'real' entrepreneur have done differently than you?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I've identified problems, built solutions, and iterated — that IS entrepreneurship. I'm already doing it.

Negative_Script: What if my business fails after graduation?
Hint_for_Reframe: What skills have you built that transfer regardless?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: Even if this venture doesn't scale, I've built skills in problem-solving, leadership, and resilience that serve me anywhere.

Negative_Script: I should have it all figured out by now.
Hint_for_Reframe: Says who? What's the actual timeline?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: There is no 'should' timeline. I'm building at my pace, and every iteration gets me closer.

Negative_Script: I'm not ready to mentor others — I still have too much to learn.
Hint_for_Reframe: Does a mentor need to be perfect, or just one step ahead?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I don't need to know everything to help someone who's one step behind me. Teaching deepens my own understanding.

Negative_Script: Success feels fragile — like it could disappear at any moment.
Hint_for_Reframe: What systems have you built that don't depend on luck?
Sample_Strong_Reframe: I've built habits, skills, and relationships that compound over time. My foundation is stronger than I give it credit for.
